188:t_10:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「I have a pretty good idea what that is. I'm ready whenever you are.」

188:t_10:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go! Let's give it our all today...!」

188:t_10:58.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! I certainly received your full effort, $$タケル$$!」

188:t_10:59.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Do your best, $$タケル$$... The time will surely come when $n's growth intersects with your fate...)

189:t_000:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch... What the hell is this...?」

189:t_000:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Naked killing intent... And a bottomless darkness that seems to drag your consciousness away...」

189:t_001:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...I'll leave it to you, $$尸刻$$.」

189:t_001:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I knew you'd show up sooner or later if we fought the Empire...!」

189:t_001:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「This is a good opportunity! We'll break through you and descend to Earth!」

189:t_001:6.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I see... It's quite understandable that $$尸空#pilot$$ is interested in you.」

189:t_001:8.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「She's as much of a cool beauty as ever... No, that's not quite it.」

189:t_001:9.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah... She's more like a woman in mourning. She's damn sexy, but I wouldn't make a move on her.」

189:t_001:10.en:
$$クラン$$
「Even at a time like this, those $$スナンパーズ$$...!」

189:t_001:11.en:
$$マオ$$
「But in their own way, they seem to sense how dangerous that woman $$尸刻$$ is.」

189:t_001:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What do you mean, that man is interested in us?」

189:t_001:13.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Even among Earth's people, you are particularly full of the power of life.」

189:t_001:14.en:
$$尸刻$$
「That is the furthest thing from us, the people of $$鬼宿$$...」

189:t_001:18.en:
$$シュレード$$
「I didn't return from the brink of death for nothing.」

189:t_001:19.en:
$$シュレード$$
「The aura around her, her companions, and $$尸空#pilot$$... It's the opposite of life's power - the vitality and emotions of living people.」

189:t_001:20.en:
$$シュレード$$
「But that doesn't mean they're dead themselves. They probably place themselves alongside people's deaths.」

189:t_001:22.en:
$$シュレード$$
「That's exactly the right description.」

189:t_001:24.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$沈黙の巨蟹$$'s $$スフィア$$...」

189:t_001:25.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Someone that creepy is a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of $$新地球皇国$$...!?」

189:t_001:26.en:
$$勝平$$
「That scorpion bastard was the same! All the Empire's Reactors are gloomy creeps!」

189:t_001:29.en:
$$セツコ$$
「His silence... his emptiness won't be shaken in the slightest by words like those.」

189:t_001:30.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Mmm...! Hearing that actually makes me want to fight even more!」

189:t_001:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Defeating an obvious villain like that with a burning heart! That's what a hero of justice does!」

189:t_001:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$! $$ノノ$$'s an android, and she's far more human than you!」

189:t_002:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Our insults and provocations don't reach that man...!」

189:t_002:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「He's like a dark, bottomless pit.」

189:t_002:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then we'll overwhelm him with force.」

189:t_002:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If words won't reach him, we have no choice.」

189:t_002:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, remember we're near the upper atmosphere!」

189:t_002:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We still have atmospheric entry ahead of us! Consider eight minutes your operational limit!」

189:t_002:8.en:
$n
「We'll beat him in those eight minutes!」

189:t_002:9.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The $$悲しみの乙女$$, the $$傷だらけの獅子$$... and the $$いがみ合う双子$$...」

189:t_003:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even that won't break through his defenses!?」

189:t_003:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The $$沈黙の巨蟹$$...! That emptiness is terrifying!」

189:t_003:3.en:
$n
「Damn it! We're both Reactors! Why can't I beat him!?」

189:t_003:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But I'll never cooperate with you! Not now, not ever!」

189:t_003:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What do you mean!? Are you saying $n hasn't mastered the $$スフィア$$!?」

189:t_003:17.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It's understandable. That's the kind of $$スフィア$$ it is.」

189:t_003:18.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It would be cruel to expect you to do what even $$ガドライト#pilot$$ couldn't.」

189:t_003:19.en:
$n
「I defeated him and took his $$スフィア$$...! I'll surpass that man!」

context_decisions: Shikoku explicitly woman by scene. Sniper pair objectification retains source force. Schrade reads death-adjacent aura, not literal undead status. Sphere names tokenized. Shikuu considers Hibiki without progress rather than powerless generally.
uncertain: 189:t_003:14: mu-i rendered achieved nothing, reflecting lack of advancement contrasted with Rand/Setsuko.
change_log: 2026-10-07: Fresh source-only English retranslation; restored settled subjects and verbs, preserved controls and row boundaries, resolved glossary identities, checked dialogue layout.
